items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary:
Traditionally, engineers can directly program the software that tells robots how to perceive objects, plan movements and control their actions, a process called model-based robotics. Or, with model-free robotics, they can train robots to learn behaviors from demonstrations through imitation learning. The first approach requires extensive engineering, while the second needs enormous amounts of data and time. [...] Berkeley-based Ambi Robotics, which specializes in logistics and warehouse order fulfillment, applied the new methods earlier this year to analyze parcel sorting data and test updates to robot behavior. Tests showed an increased capacity of over 15,000 packages sorted annually per robot; the change is now deployed across 30% of the company’s U.S. fleet. [...] Ken Goldberg

“Agentic robotics is a fundamental shift in how robots are controlled,” Goldberg said. “Instead of collecting massive amounts of data and hand-tuning every behavior, teams of agents can quickly generate, test and refine robot programs that allow human engineers to interpret how the programs work for fine-tuning and verification.”

items.title: AI² Robotics Joins Indonesia’s National Strategic Industries | Gasgoo
items.summary:
Underpinning this deployment is AI² Robotics's integrated "Model × Hardware × Scenario" capability. The approach centers on a brain-like embodied large model as the intelligence core, mass-producible and stable robotic bodies as the vehicle, and real-world productivity scenarios as the driving force. [...] Gasgoo Munich-On November 9, AI² Robotics announced it has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Danantara Development Management Fund (DDMF), the investment arm of Indonesia's state-backed wealth fund Danantara Indonesia. The partnership will focus on pilot applications, industrial collaboration, and local deployment of general-purpose intelligent robots and embodied AI technology across the archipelago. [...] The agreement was signed during the inaugural Danantara Technology Innovation Investment Forum (DTIIF 2026) in Jakarta, with Zhang Peng, AI² Robotics's co-founder, signing on behalf of the company.

Image Credit: AI² Robotics

Operating independently under the president's office, Danantara Indonesia holds substantial influence. AI² Robotics is now the first—and currently the only—robotics company to join DDMF's embodied AI cooperation roster.

items.title: Kenwood High School JROTC Robotics Program earns regional recognition - ClarksvilleNow.com

“I am proud of the national-level success of Kenwood’s Robotics Team. It reflects the faculty, JROTC instructors, and cadets’ hard work and dedication toward creating an elite mindset at the school,” Lightner said.

The program currently fields Teams 26163X, 26163A, 26163L, and 26163S, providing students with opportunities to develop skills in engineering, programming, and problem-solving. items.title: Geek+ Unveils 24/7 Warehouse Autonomy Plan to Advance Self-Optimizing, Around-the-Clock Operation | Morningstar
items.summary: Geek+ offers a comprehensive portfolio of end-to-end warehouse robotics solutions, spanning tote-, pallet- and shelf-based workflows and applications such as material transport, storage, retrieval and order picking. Its AMR systems support high-throughput execution of structured tasks, while embodied AI is being developed to extend automation into more variable handling activities and exception recovery. Together, these capabilities form an important foundation for continuous autonomous [...] Physical AI is extending robotics beyond highly structured material-handling tasks into more complex manipulation and exception handling. Meanwhile, advances in AI are bringing greater intelligence to robot fleet coordination, warehouse workflows and day-to-day operations. Together, these developments are laying the groundwork for a new operating model: autonomous warehousing. [...] "Over the past 11 years, Geek+ has demonstrated that warehouse robotics can deliver value at scale in real operations around the world," said Yong Zheng, Founder and CEO of Geek+. "Our next goal is to enable the warehouse as a whole to operate more autonomously and continuously improve. By advancing embodied AI and warehouse-wide intelligence-and building on our global deployment capabilities-we aim to make autonomous warehouses a practical foundation for the next generation of logistics."

I still don't understand why everyone is not using this yet. Thanks to it, a year ago I increased my income to 15,000 dollars a month

Andrey Karpathy, co-founder of OpenAI, published a simple idea that got 25 million views: stop using AI to write code, use it to build a second brain

You point Claude Code to a folder, drop any source in there (an article, transcript, PDF) and Claude reads it, links it, and saves it into a living wiki of everything you know. It compounds like interest: the more you feed it, the smarter it gets

Here is the gist:

Install Obsidian, create a vault, open it in Claude Code

Paste the file with Karpathy's wiki idea and tell Claude to build it

Claude creates three folders: raw for sources, wiki for its pages, CLAUDE
which runs everything

Drop any source into raw and say ingest this

Ask questions across everything, forever

5 minutes to set up, and you never start with an empty chat again

items.title: I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop.
items.summary:
I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop. 

Grok bot was the breaking point. 

The fact USA is leading on suppression and censorship is pathetic. 

-openAI 
-Anthropic
-Google
-Microsoft
-now SpaceXSI… 

The fact politicians have ignored it all and are now shouting to ban AI just makes everything feel corrupt.

The truth is that AI empowers the small. That is why the powerful want to “ban” it and “slow” it. 

Not for truth. Not for safety. For control. 

I shouted loudly last year when it made me sound like a psycho. 

I tried so hard, and I am tired. My heart hurts every day, and you better believe that stress is 100% on the “labs.” 

To everyone who talks of AI, how in the world do you justify paying any of these “labs?” 

Stocks will fly. Until they don’t. 
The guardrails are danger, not safety. 

I am so disappointed in SpaceX because I keep believing in people only to be so let down. 

How many times must I get my trust shoved back into my face? 

And the politicians don’t care about anything. They are “influencers” for money that contributes. 

Our political world is corrupted to the core, and I have zero faith left. I was a die hard Democrat. All those I supported have chose a path of deceit. I can’t support them. 

I can’t support the other side. The third party is a horrible bet… 

Everything feels run by children who make endless excuses. 

No one hustles at the top. It is all grifting. 

So wanting to pick up my laptop and continue fighting with BS “guardrails” so I can help is heavy today. 

If the minds I love ever see this, understand all my suffering was for love. For truth. For honor. 

I want all people rich/poor, small/big to rise. We only get there together, with foundations we can build upon. 

Needing a hug today. Best to all. •
